amendments.reason: Initial canonical adoption of the ATLAS Universal Constitution and its immutable safeguards.
amendments.impact-assessment: Creates mandatory human-dignity, safety, privacy, accountability, AI/robotics, and spiritual-interpretation safeguards across ATLAS.
amendments.rollback-record: Any rollback must restore a previously pinned constitutional baseline and preserve a visible audit record.
amendments.independent-review-for-high-impact-chang: Required before any amendment that changes protected rights, safety boundaries, or high-impact system governance.
